title: Seeking to Impress
synopsis: Little Wang learns the hard way that seeking to impress by feigning more than his abilities is not a good idea.

fullText.simplified:
打肿脸充胖子

    小王刚参加工作不久。一天，他收到了公司同事的结婚请帖，邀请他参加婚礼。小王很愉快地答应了，但是很快就高兴不起来了。
    参加婚礼是需要给红包的，同事们都说会给一千元。小王刚开始工作，工资只有一千二百块，一千块的红包对小王来说就是个天文数字。但是小王怕红包给少了，同事们会看不起他，只能打肿脸充胖子，也给了一千块。
    参加完婚礼，小王穷得只能每天吃方便面了。有位同事好心提醒小王：“小王，不能天天吃方便面，对身体不好。”小王挠了挠头说：“没事儿，最近家里天天吃肉，实在太腻了，吃点方便面解解腻。”
    吃了半个月方便面后，小王一看见方便面就想吐。他决定以后再也不干打肿脸充胖子的事儿了。
fullText.traditional:
打腫臉充胖子

    小王剛參加工作不久。一天，他收到了公司同事的結婚請帖，邀請他參加婚禮。小王很愉快地答應了，但是很快就高興不起來了。
    參加婚禮是需要給紅包的，同事們都說會給一千元。小王剛開始工作，工資只有一千二百塊，一千塊的紅包對小王來說就是個天文數字。但是小王怕紅包給少了，同事們會看不起他，只能打腫臉充胖子，也給了一千塊。
    參加完婚禮，小王窮得只能每天吃方便麵了。有位同事好心提醒小王：“小王，不能天天吃方便麵，對身體不好。”小王撓了撓頭說：“沒事兒，最近家裡天天吃肉，實在太膩了，吃點方便麵解解膩。”
    吃了半個月方便麵後，小王一看見方便麵就想吐。他決定以後再也不幹打腫臉充胖子的事兒了。

raw.synopsis: Little Wang learns the hard way that seeking to impress by feigning more than his abilities is not a good idea.
sentence_translations: Seeking to Impress by Feigning More Than One’s Abilities
Little Wang had not been in the job for long.
One day, he received a wedding invitation from his colleague inviting him to come to his wedding.
Little Wang very cheerfully agreed, but very quickly he was no longer happy.
Attending a wedding requires one to give money in a red envelope.
His colleagues all said they would give 1000 yuan.
Little Wang had just started the job and his salary was only 1200 yuan.
1000 yuan for a red envelope was for Little Wang an astronomical figure.
But Little Wang was afraid that if his red envelope contained less, his colleagues would look down on him.
He could only impress by feigning more than his abilities, so he also gave 1000 yuan.
After attending the wedding, Little Wang was so poor that he had no choice but to eat instant noodles every day.
A colleague kindly reminded Little Wang, “Little Wang, you can’t eat instant noodles every day. It’s not good for you.”
Little Wang scratched his head and said, ..
.. “It’s nothing. Recently at home I have been eating meat every day and it’s really too greasy.
I’m eating some instant noodles to cleanse my palate.”
After eating instant noodles for half a month, Little Wang wanted to throw up as soon as he saw instant noodles.
He decided that he would never again do anything to try to impress by feigning more than his abilities.
